mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% signals labor market weakness, leading to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not rise above 5.5% within the next 3 months, or 20-day returns remain non-negative when the trigger occurs.

mechanism_narrative: An upward trend in demand (GDPC1) combined with a downward trend in supply (INDPRO) creates a demand-supply imbalance, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The combination of GDPC1 up and INDPRO down does not lead to significantly positive 20-day returns (p > 0.05 in t-test), or the interaction effect is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate increases discount rates, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In a monetary tightening cycle, FEDFUNDS rise does not result in negative 20-day returns, or the tightening cycle is not active during the period.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the number of unemployed persons (PAYEMS) above 140,000 signals labor market stress, reducing consumer confidence and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS does not cross above 140 within the next month, or 20-day returns remain non-negative when the trigger occurs.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and the number of unemployed persons (PAYEMS) indicates severe labor market weakness, compressing corporate profits and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The simultaneous rise in UNRATE and PAYEMS does not lead to significantly negative 20-day returns (p > 0.05), or the interaction effect is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged 60-day decline in the federal funds rate signals sustained monetary easing, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: A 60-day decline in FEDFUNDS does not precede significantly positive 60-day S&P 500 returns (p > 0.05), or the decline is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A short-term drop in the federal funds rate followed by an immediate rise in demand (GDPC1) within the same month signals immediate policy accommodation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS down and GDPC1 up in the same month
failure_condition: The short-term drop in FEDFUNDS followed by GDPC1 rise within the same month does not result in significantly positive 5-day returns (p > 0.05).
